description: Read a compact structural composition view by default, preserving observed ETag, authority metadata, clip timing, token values and source pins without large HTML bodies. Ordinary exact-ETag reads can omit includeDependencies. With includeDependencies=true, compact returns a dependency key/size index, not executable tokens; these tokens can contain full sources. Request explicit dependencyKeys for exact selected tokens, or response:"full" for all tokens. Selection does not establish a sufficient operation basis. Use clipIds:[id] with response:"full" for complete exact selected sources; unknown IDs are refused. Use response:"full" without clipIds for the original full backend JSON. Local response/clipIds/dependencyKeys arguments never reach the backend. READ BACK a composition as JSON — the edit itself: tracks, clips, card HTML, reframe segments, captions, markers, format. This is what create_render encodes, so it is also what you hand to validate_composition (which needs a full inline composition body), what you diff after an edit, and what you archive/share so someone else can re-render the SAME video. Read-only and free. Authoring stays op-based (apply_composition) — do not round-trip this object back as a write. A composition too large for routine model context can be read selectively with clipIds and response:"full"; the compact view explicitly identifies omitted source bodies. Defaults to the project's ACTIVE composition; pass `compositionId` to read a specific one (the same id apply_composition takes as `composition_id`, and preview_frame / create_render take as compositionId) so an A/B variant can be read back, not just written. The result includes the exact HTTP etag string; copy it to apply_composition.body.if_match (the numeric revision is not an ETag). In a compose session this reads the session's scratch, the composition its edits, previews and renders target. Pass includeDependencies="true" on a v1 guarded endpoint to read composition_id, revision and dependency tokens. With componentExecutionVersions=["3","4"], this envelope also returns expectedBrandIdentity from the persisted project authority; carry it unchanged into the matching negotiated write. Preserve those observed tokens when authoring; never refresh the basis to hide a conflict. BOTH shapes carry `needsUpgrade` when clips are stored in a retired form (unpinned or TSX component placements, removed primitives): each entry names the clipId, the kind and, when one exists, the native successor pin — move those with repin_component and rebuild the rest with create_component; such a composition will not save or render as-is. Absent when nothing needs upgrading.

clipIds.description: Read only these exact clip IDs. With response full their complete sources are returned. Unknown and duplicate IDs are refused. Omit for all clips.

componentExecutionVersions.description: The component execution versions this reader accepts, one parameter per version: 3, or 3 and 4 (native placements). Absent readers accept only the historical protocol.

compositionId.description: Read a SPECIFIC composition instead of the project's active one. Omit it and the active composition is returned. Pairs with `composition_id` on the apply op: an edit you can make to a second composition is one you can read back.

dependencyKeys.description: Select these exact existing dependency keys from includeDependencies=true. Tokens are returned byte-for-byte; unknown or duplicate keys are refused. This selection does not establish that the basis is sufficient for an operation.

includeDependencies.description: Return the immutable composition identity, project revision and shared v1 dependency expectations alongside the composition.

response.description: MCP response view. Default compact omits repeated source bodies. Full returns the complete backend receipt or requested sources. This does not change the saved composition.

session_id.description: Compose-session id: read that session's SCRATCH composition (what the session has been editing) instead of the active one. Mutually exclusive with `compositionId`. An unknown, foreign or scratch-less session is a 404, never the active composition.

name: get_composition

anyOf.description: Verbatim backend JSON object, or an explicitly identified full selected-clip view.

title: Get Composition
